scenario: bounded concurrent authenticated POSTs from a local browser
failure: Authenticated preflight failed. Sign in through the dedicated normal Chrome test profile first.
notes: Only localhost is contacted; authentication, quotas and queue remain enabled.
No session identifiers, cookies, emails, tokens or evidence text are recorded.
Requests in each wave are initiated together through standard same-origin fetch.
HTTP 429 may be rate limiting OR queue admission rejection; check server logs to distinguish.
End-to-end request latency is not a direct measurement of queue wait time.
Small-sample p95 cannot be used as a production SLA or capacity estimate.
Do not treat a completed 200 with an unexpected verdict as a passed correctness check.
